categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Yuxing Film Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of special functional polyester films. Its main product lines include electronic optical polyester films, photovoltaic polyester films, electrical insulation polyester films, textile yarn polyester films, and power battery polyester films. The company also extends into precision coating processing through its subsidiary, focusing on electronic and new energy materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced biaxially oriented polyester film (BOPET) technology with proprietary dual-stretch thick film processes. It operates a dedicated functional polyester film technology R&D center equipped with pilot polymerization and extrusion lines, multi-layer co-extrusion systems, and comprehensive testing facilities. The firm emphasizes continuous innovation through collaborations with Zhejiang University and Changzhou University, focusing on product differentiation via raw material modification, process design, formula optimization, and equipment upgrades.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include brand enterprises in consumer electronics, photovoltaic backsheet manufacturers, electrical insulation sectors, and power battery producers. The company serves industries such as LED/LCD display backlight materials, solar energy, electrical motors, transformers, textile machinery, and new energy vehicles. It has strategic partnerships with leading downstream brands and supplies to first-tier brand supply chains domestically and internationally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates within China, headquartered in Changzhou, Jiangsu Province, with domestic sales accounting for over 95% of revenue. It also has a growing export business managed by a dedicated foreign sales department, contributing approximately 4.6% of total revenue. The firm benefits from the industrial cluster and logistics advantages of the Yangtze River Delta region.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Yuxing operates mainly in the midstream segment of the polyester film supply chain, focusing on manufacturing functional polyester films from polyester chips. It also extends downstream through coating and composite processing to add functional layers for specific applications. The company collaborates closely with upstream raw material suppliers and downstream brand customers to customize products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include transitioning towards high-value, differentiated, and functional polyester films, especially in electronic optical applications. It invests heavily in R&D to develop new products such as OCA optical adhesive films, high-temperature matte films for automotive applications, polarizer protective films, environmentally friendly flame-retardant films, and ultra-low density reflective films. The firm also focuses on digital transformation, quality improvement, and expanding its patent portfolio to enhance competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of polyester film products to industrial customers, with a smaller portion through distributor channels. The company also earns income from coating and processing services via its subsidiary. Pricing is contract-based, negotiated with customers, and revenue is recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance. The firm also receives government subsidies and investment income from equity holdings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiangsu Yuxing is one of the largest domestic producers of special functional polyester films in China, holding leading market shares in photovoltaic backsheet films and electrical insulation films. It competes with both domestic and international players, including Japanese and Korean manufacturers who dominate high-end functional polyester films. The company aims to break import dependence by enhancing R&D and product quality to capture more high-end market segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.1 billion, a 34.75% decline from the previous year, mainly due to reduced demand in photovoltaic polyester films. It incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 357 million. Total assets stood at RMB 3.63 billion with net assets of RMB 2.28 billion, reflecting a 16.57% increase year-over-year. The company is investing in capacity expansion and technology upgrades, with ongoing projects expected to complete by mid-2027.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu Yuxing emphasizes functional, high-quality, differentiated, and multi-variety polyester films tailored to specific industrial applications. Its products feature superior dimensional stability, insulation, heat resistance, weather resistance, and optical properties. The company leverages proprietary technology, extensive patent holdings, and close customer collaboration to deliver customized solutions that enhance downstream product performance and reduce reliance on imported high-end films.
